description: Source code for a UDP receiver implementation in the Zephyr RTOS, handling socket setup, data reception, session management, and statistics reporting for network performance testing.

methods.name: build_reply
methods.description: Constructs a reply packet with session statistics to send back to the client.

methods.name: zperf_receiver_send_stat
methods.description: Sends session statistics to the specified address and socket.

methods.name: udp_received
methods.description: Processes received UDP datagrams, manages session state, and computes jitter and statistics.

methods.name: udp_receiver_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up socket services and resets session state.

methods.name: udp_recv_data
methods.description: Handles incoming data on UDP sockets, including error handling and data reception.

methods.name: udp_svc_handler
methods.description: Work handler invoked when socket events occur, triggers data reception.

methods.name: zperf_udp_receiver_init
methods.description: Initializes UDP sockets, binds to configured addresses and ports, and registers socket services.

methods.name: zperf_udp_download
methods.description: Starts UDP download session with specified parameters and callback.
